subject: english
question:
**Select the grammatically correct version of the following sentence.**

The young pirate is more cleverer than the captain of the ship.

options.text: The young pirate is cleverer to the captain of the ship.
The young pirate is cleverer than the captain of the ship.
The young pirate is most clever than the captain of the ship.
The younger pirate is cleverer than the captain of the ship.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The young pirate is cleverer than the captain of the ship.**
